notes: Cost endpoints are inherited sensitivity bounds, not validated forecasts.
Matched AEO adjusts BEV differential on both fleets; optional equal-weight generation, firming and distribution pass-through is illustrative only.
Transition holds 2050 service fixed, blends annualized costs and does not model chronological investment or retirement.
512 assumed-distribution draws, three resource supply scenarios, relaxed floor, not probabilities or confidence intervals.
Reactor learning uses original fleet fixed-point iteration.
Readiness-gated adoption assumes cost improvements occur exogenously, no more than 10 percentage points per year of fixed 2050 service, and does not establish physical deployment feasibility.
